head: 6f49ae3a717e5521051704c7055016a3ae0ccefd
summary:
The slice is data plus one test addition, and it does what the design said. eng/rules-harness/plants.json gains F20-F23, one row per SL-043 twinned entry. Each row uses an exact rule string. F20, F21 and F23 carry the `also_settled` keys the spike said they need, and the settled names match .taad/fitness.yaml:477, :485, :494 and :518 word for word. The anchors exist and are unique where they need to be: EntryClassifier.cs has a file-scoped namespace, the class is at :21 and its brace at :22, Scanner.cs:138, MainWindow.xaml.cs:523 and VolumeSpace.cs:52. The `_note` arithmetic works out: 23+3+8+5=39. The hand-only sentence is unchanged, and its SL-043/SL-044 attributions match the `# settled by` markers at fitness.yaml:473 and :503. I checked it independently:
- harness.py --engine-root taad_v3\backend (faecfc3, clean) --scenario all on this tree's own .dotnet: 52 rows, 52 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits, exit 0. F20-F23 fire/fire, and P07d is quiet/quiet in the same batch as F20.
- Clean baseline: 11 Facts, 64 rules, 0 hits.
- RuleCases.ps1 -Case C-006: all checks held, including both new decoy checks.
- RuleCases.ps1 -Case All: C-001 to C-014, all checks held, exit 0, 305 s.
- rules-parity: AGREE 11 <- 15, 27 patterns, exit 0.
- Fitness check: every rule holds.
- git status was unchanged across every run.

The C-006 decoy checks do feed O-008's shape in. The PYTHONPATH decoy's fitness.py raises on import, so if harness.py:112 appended the root instead of inserting it first, the run would exit 2. The sitecustomize preload exercises the path-equality guard at harness.py:122-124. RuleCases.ps1 has no literal that counts plants.json rows: a grep for 35/39/19/23/48/52/F17-F23 finds nothing. Nothing else in the tree outside .taad/slices counts the rows. The build declared all three of its departures: no literals to bump, re-derived F21 anchor/F22/F23 labelled in the row notes, and the wider `_note` text. The slice ran one build attempt and did not loop.

Second round: Second round, looking for ways to break the change: no new defects.

**Line endings and BOM.** The four plant target files are CRLF throughout (0 bare LF, 0 lone CR, no BOM); git stores them as i/lf and writes them out as w/crlf. harness.py `_insert` picks the file's line ending and plain() strips a BOM, so an LF checkout plants the same way.

**F20's '{' anchor.** EntryClassifier.cs has two lines that strip to '{'. The first is the class brace at :22, so the plant lands at :23. If a bare '{' is ever added above the class, the constant either stays inside EntryClassifier.cs, where both twins still fire, or lands at namespace scope, which is a CS0116 build error and a loud CannotMeasure (exit 2). It cannot go quietly unmeasured.

**Plant side effects.** harness.py:49 filters dotnet test to ArchitectureRulesTests, and the run confirms 11 tests. So F21's `.Wait()` and F22's `.Wait()` never run, and no unrelated test can fail or hang.

**Rows file round-trip.** New-RowsFile round-trips plants.json at -Depth 10, so the new single-element also_settled arrays survive C-009/C-014's rewritten files. load_rows validates every row, and -Case All passed.

**C-006 decoy checks.**
- The environment variable is saved and restored in `finally`, including when it was unset.
- If Invoke-Harness gets no python, it returns Exit -1 and both checks fail rather than pass.
- The sitecustomize check is also the witness that PYTHONPATH is honoured. An interpreter that ignores PYTHONPATH (-E, or a ._pth embeddable) would make it exit 0 instead of 2, so the PYTHONPATH-decoy check cannot pass vacuously.
- Both expected paths come from the same string on both sides: GetTempPath/GetFullPath against Python's abspath of the same entry. 8.3 or forward-slash forms therefore match, and the comparison ignores case.

**Temp folders.** My runs' temp dirs were removed (checked by ID). The fsa-* leftovers in %TEMP% come from other, older or concurrent runs, not from a cleanup path this diff adds.

obligations.evidence: eng/rules-harness/plants.json F20: TheClassifierListsNoLinkTags (*.cs), with also_settled matching fitness.yaml:477 exactly. The anchor '{' is EntryClassifier.cs:22 (class at :21, file-scoped namespace at :4), so the plant lands at :23. My --scenario all run: F20 fire/fire AS-RECORDED, and P07d is quiet/quiet in the same batch 1.

F21 plants `_store.VolumeUsedSource.Task.Wait();` after Scanner.cs:138. That matches the Core pattern at fitness.yaml:201 and the settled rule at :485, both of which the row names. My run: F21 fire/fire AS-RECORDED, 0 stray. The App glob (src/FsAnalyser.App/**) cannot match Scanner.cs, and a hit there would show as STRAY-HIT under judge().

F22 plants `result.Store.VolumeUsed.Wait();` after MainWindow.xaml.cs:523. That matches the App pattern at fitness.yaml:209. The settled rule at :396-401 allows `result.Store` through its lookbehind. My run: F22 fire/fire AS-RECORDED, 0 stray.

F21 and F22 use the exact yaml names 'NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure (Core)' and '(App)' (fitness.yaml:198, :206). judge() at harness.py:512-548 matches them exactly for fitness and uses base() for xunit. In my run both are planted in batch 1 together, and both came out AS-RECORDED, so each hit went to its own row by file and line (harness.py:486-507).

F23 plants `Store.ScanStore? store = null;` after VolumeSpace.cs:52. also_settled names fitness.yaml:494 and :518 exactly, and judge() requires both to fire (wanted includes settled). My run: F23 fire/fire AS-RECORDED.
My run's clean line: xunit 11 Facts, 0 hits | fitness unable, 64 rules, 117 files read, 0 hits, none unmatched, CLEAN. The only rule NOT RUN is the import rule, which the design accepted.

I re-ran harness.py --engine-root taad_v3\backend (HEAD faecfc3, porcelain empty) --scenario all against this tree: 52 rows, 52 AS-RECORDED, 0 not, 0 stray hits, exit 0, 18 s. F01-F19, P07c-e, S01-S13 and D1-D13 all unchanged. The result matches .taad/slices/SL-075/recording-run.stdout.txt.

tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1:670-701. A decoy taad3 on PYTHONPATH, which sits ahead of site-packages and so is a stricter test than a shared venv, and whose fitness.py raises if imported: the run stays CLEAN with exit 0, and the header names <root>\taad3\fitness.py. A sitecustomize-preloaded decoy makes it exit 2 with 'imported from ..., not from this root'. I ran -Case C-006 myself and all checks held.

A grep of RuleCases.ps1 for \b(35|39|19|23|48|52)\b|F1[7-9]|F2[0-3] finds 0 matches. C-008's $MustFire (line 754) is 1..16, passed through --only, not a row count. -Case All, which I ran: all checks held, exit 0.
pwsh eng/rules-parity.ps1 gives AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 49 settled entries, exit 0. The diff touches only plants.json, RuleCases.ps1 and .taad/slices files.
My own --scenario all run on the committed 39-row plants.json (not a scratch plants file): 52/52 AS-RECORDED, and the 48 pre-existing rows kept their recorded outcomes.

This tree's gitignored .dotnet\sdk\10.0.401 exists (Test-Path True), populated by eng/dotnet.ps1 under Q-003. My harness run built the scratch copy with it in 6 s, without --dotnet-from. The builder's record also shows the --dotnet-from SL-074 route working.

cases.evidence: plants.json F20 plants the exact named constant in EntryClassifier.cs. In --scenario all it shares batch 1 with P07d, which appends to the same file, and both are AS-RECORDED. D3 is a divergences row and is never in the same scratch tree, so that half of the shape is vacuous rather than untested.
F21 is a real Core plant in Scanner.cs. The App entry's silence is enforced by judge()'s STRAY-HIT/extra check on hits in F21's span.

F22 is a real App plant in MainWindow.xaml.cs. xunit fire comes from the one Fact's hit inside F22's span, and the fitness hit is the App entry only. A Core-entry hit is impossible by glob and would have been extra.
F21 and F22 run together in batch 1 of --scenario all, with distinct exact rule strings. Both AS-RECORDED, so neither string is a near-miss.
F23's also_settled lists both settled ScanStore rules, and judge() puts settled into the wanted set for fitness, so both had to fire for AS-RECORDED.
The harness's clean pass runs before every scenario. My run: 11 Facts, 64 rules, 0 hits, CLEAN.
My --scenario all run on the committed file: 52/52 AS-RECORDED, divergences.json untouched.
RuleCases.ps1 C-006 new checks: a PYTHONPATH decoy whose import raises, and a sitecustomize-preloaded decoy. Both feed a second importable taad3 in, and both passed when I ran them.
The grep finds no row-count literal. -Case All passes against the 39-row file.
Material false, not owed. The reason still holds: harness.py is unchanged, and judge() at :545-548 turns any fired rule not in wanted into STRAY-HIT.
Material false. The reason still holds: .taad/slices/SL-075/ holds only .json and .txt, with no .cs.
Material false. The reason still holds: eng/dotnet.ps1 is unchanged, and this tree now has its own .dotnet/sdk/10.0.401.

drift: No undeclared departures. The build declared three: (1) RuleCases.ps1 has no row-count literals to bump, and its only edit is two decoy-engine checks in C-006; (2) F21's anchor and all of F22 and F23 are re-derived rather than transcribed, and each row note says so; (3) the `_note` text goes beyond the two counts. All three check out against the tree.
The C-006 title line in RuleCases.ps1:620 still reads 'exit 2 naming the path', but the new PYTHONPATH-decoy check expects exit 0 CLEAN. The title is now slightly narrower than the case.

No undeclared departures beyond those the first round recorded. The three declared departures (no literals to bump, re-derived rows labelled in their notes, the wider `_note` text) still stand as described.
